newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper and zinc rise on global uptrends.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper and zinc rise on global uptrends.

text.p: Indian copper and zinc prices gained on Thursday on the back of rising global prices, dealers said. Other base metals were steady in a narrow price band.
Ready copper rose by 50 rupees to 12,600 rupees per quintal while zinc gained by 100 rupees to 6,650 rupees. Zinc was up by 50 rupees on Wednesday.
Nickel was steady at 36,900 rupees per quintal but the undercurrent was firm on reports of a world market upsurge. Tin was traded at the previous level of 34,600 rupees per quintal.
So was aluminium at 7,200 rupees and lead at 4,450 rupees.
